🇷🇺 🇺🇦 Mass Strike on Krivoy Rog Russian forces launched a massive attack on enemy targets in Krivoy Rog , Dnepropetrovsk region. Night and morning strikes by "Geran-4" drones continued against the city. Authorities confirmed damage to industrial enterprises, warehouses, shopping centres, and infrastructure, alongside several major fires. Agricultural machinery and outbuildings were also hit. The strikes caused serious power supply issues, temporarily halting municipal electric transport. Backup power sources were activated for water and heating systems. These repeated disruptions strain the city's energy resilience and require significant resources for repairs and fuel. @Slavyangrad
